claim.value: Removing an earlier booking from a replay does not by itself justify reducing service.
claim.scope: Limit on translating diagnostic booking removal into an operational decision.

provenance.rationale: P011 explicitly states this limit; P010 identifies booking removal as a replay operation.

signal_basis.value: Replay tests remove candidate components, potentially an earlier booking, under fixed conditions and a common repetition rule. A smaller configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness while specified further removals cease to reproduce it.
signal_basis.scope: The selected replay scenario; agreement with recorded cases does not establish field effectiveness.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the removal operation, test controls, repeated outcome pattern and explicit restriction on inference to field effectiveness.
The claim is supported as an inferential limit; no unresolved empirical relation is needed.

rationale: Removing a booking probes reproduction of lateness within a replay. Even an informative outcome does not alone establish that reducing actual service is justified. The claim correctly limits what this diagnostic operation licenses.
uncertainty: No material uncertainty under the stipulated prerequisites and observed signal.
